summary:
**Verdict: nothing blocks committing the bounded source change and evidence under the explicit waiver.** I found no hidden retry, no skipped phase, no failed gate shown as a pass, and no post-frame script presented as prospective. Two small cosmetic items and one ordering requirement are below; none needs new timing or changes to frozen files.

I ran as Opus 5.5 (`claude-opus-5-5`, Anthropic) and stayed read-only. I made no edits and ran no builds, tests, services, workloads, timing or delegation. I ran only `python3 -I verify.py` from `/tmp`, a few hash and diff comparisons, and `ps`/`docker`/`ss` checks.

## Offline verifier
- `python3 -I E/verify.py` exited 0 in 0.27s and wrote nothing. Its output matches `portable-audit-r1.json`, and the `SHA256SUMS` hash is `a19a5976…`, the same as the recorded snapshot.
- **No relabelling.**
  - All 5 post-frame scripts are listed in `post-frame-artifacts.json`. The verifier checks they are absent from `frame.json`.
  - The other 15 `.py` files are frozen inputs. No script is unlabelled.
  - `source-r1.patch` is marked superseded by `tracked.patch` (`7b0b5ae9…`). The live `git diff HEAD` of the 2 source files is byte-identical to `tracked.patch`, and frame HEAD is `a39915dc`.
- **Failed gate stays failed.** The verifier requires postgres exit 101, `all_exit_zero` false, `full_source_acceptance` false and `product_acceptance` false. It also requires the same four failures with the WAL-preflight cause as the baseline. That baseline `postgres.txt` (`e8e61eca`) and `ACCEPTANCE.md` (`629f433a`) are byte-identical to the committed copies, and the waiver text is at `ACCEPTANCE.md:77` in HEAD.
- **Raw evidence is checked.** The verifier recomputes all three phases from raw per-invocation logs: 128 invocations and 19,178,971 checked operations. It reruns `check_regression` against the archived baseline TSV and checks the regression identity hashes. It also rehashes 693 archived inputs and both source snapshots.
- **README wording** says "retained under the existing recovery waiver … not an accepted source batch", with nothing claiming it was accepted.

## Transcript audit (thread `ef773c6d`, run 575, `gpt-6.1-sol`)
**Scope I read:**
- **Messages view, positions 10900–11439:** read completely in one page, `hasMore=false`. It returned 67 items, all assistant messages and none from the user, starting at position 10914.
- **Activity view, positions 11001–11400:** read completely across four pages at 500 characters per item. I read every command, file change, tool call, subagent and notification in that range. I fetched full text for 11137 (frame build), 11140 (frame console) and 11364 (qualifier edit).

**Not covered:**
- Activity view 10900–11000. This is the pretrial r1 review period, covered only by messages and the trail.
- Activity view 11401–11447. This is the export and final work, covered only by messages.
- The text of reasoning items, which I did not read.
- Command output beyond 500 characters, except for the three items above.

**Launches, each exactly once, in agreement with the trail:**

| What | Position | When (UTC) | Detail |
|---|---|---|---|
| Untimed diagnostics | 11117 | before freeze | Script refuses to run once `frame.json` exists |
| `prepare_frame` | 11137 | 21:36:08 | Console shows frame `3e976b83…`, matching `launch-health` and the file |
| `run_measurements.py` | 11143 | 21:37 → 22:19:24 | Single run for primary, dirty control and confirmation; progress checks were reads only |
| `run_source_gates.py` | 11253 | 22:20:51 → 22:35:37 | Single run, exit 1; includes `test:pg --force` and `run_regress` |
| `cleanup_measurements` | 11264 | — | Single run |
| `cleanup_source_gates` | 11386 | — | Single run |
| `qualify_source_gates` | 11373 | — | Single run |

- After the `point_in_time_branches` failure (11297), positions 11298–11314 only read source and docs. The suite was not rerun.
- The commands marked failed at 11347, 11355 and 11397 were `tail`/`cat` reads of files that did not exist yet, not gate reruns.
- **Trail:** the 14 exported rows are identical to the canonical trail from 20:42:55Z onward, and every row timestamp matches its log command in the transcript. The only test retry was focused r1→r2 before the frame (SQLSTATE 25001 setup failure), and it is disclosed at 20:47:46Z.
- **Live state, rechecked read-only now:**
  - All 10 recorded PIDs are gone: 8 from measurement and 2 from regression.
  - All 6 recorded containers are gone: 4 helpers and 2 from regression.
  - The 8 removed fixture copies are absent.
  - Port 53720 is free.
  - No `roll.home` containers remain.

## Cosmetic findings (not blockers)
1. **Qualifier edited after reading the log.** `qualify_source_gates.py` was written at 22:35:06 and edited at 22:35:37 (position 11364), after `postgres.log` had been read. The edit replaced a test name that does not exist (`daemon_owns_postgres_lifecycle`) with `serves_requests_and_adopts_compute_after_restart`, which exists (`service.rs:190`) and passed (`postgres.log:64`).
   - The first version never ran, and the edit does not weaken the failure-set, exit-101 or "stays failed" checks. It is already labelled post-frame.
   - The phrase "actual-daemon lifecycle passed" refers to that rolld service test; `daemon.log` is only its service log. It is worth one README line if the README is touched again.
2. **Trail "start" row.** The row at 22:33:12Z marks a resume after context compaction (activity 11315 at 22:30:43Z) within the same run 575. Its "prior rows 20:47:46…" omits the 20:42:55 premise row.

## Required before commit
The verifier compares the manifest against every file in E. After adding this review, the audit receipt and the final trail rows, regenerate `SHA256SUMS` and rerun `verify.py`; otherwise it will fail. The 569 files are already staged: the 2 source files plus 567 export files. `target/` is 66 GB, as you said.
